name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Fix the real cause of silent deploy/preview failures: every action button was named 'action', which collides with HTMLFormElement's own reserved .action property (HTMLFormElement uses [OverrideBuiltins], so a control named 'action' shadows the form's built-in property). Some browsers then silently omit that control's name/value from native form submission entirely, even though event.submitter correctly identifies the clicked button. Renamed the dispatch field to afm_action everywhere (buttons, hidden inputs, JS checks, server-side reads).

Fix silent deploy/preview failure: implicit Enter-key form submission (from a typeahead pick or any text field) activated no button, so action= was omitted entirely and the server silently no-op'd with no error. Typeahead Enter handlers now always preventDefault, and a form-wide guard blocks implicit Enter-submission from plain text fields. Added a server-side fallback message for defense in depth.
